brief: Apply the loading restriction in MG-023 in preference to accepting the exposure if the ageing unit cannot be attended before the event. As stated in MG-021, record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified. The supplied documents do not cover the cooling type, accumulated heat, or load figures listed in the asset facts, so no guidance is provided for those specific values.
